products.label: JPL Horizons, satellite ephemerides SAT455 to SAT459
products.process: Take every confirmed Saturn moon in the retained JPL catalogue that has no object package and has a Horizons code; ask Horizons for its geometric position relative to Saturn's centre at the world's epoch; draw one dot at that position, coloured by its dynamical group from its mean inclination.
limitations: A dot's colour names its dynamical group and its size is a display choice; neither measures the moon, which is a few kilometres across and would be invisible at scale.
S/2009 S1 and S/2009 S2 have no Horizons ephemeris and are not drawn.
